remarks: Calling all condo shoppers, downsizers, investors, and more! Don't miss your chance to see this 2 Bed, 2 Full Bath, open concept TOP FLOOR END UNIT in beautiful Victorian Manor. This one has all you could want in one buttoned-up package! New roof in 2023, Central Air (installed 2020), washer/dryer IN UNIT, deeded reserved garage space (space #25) in attached garage with ample 2nd car off-street parking, elevator in building, low $416/month HOA fees which include water and sewer, newer stainless steel refrigerator, the list goes on! Pet-friendly and investor-friendly complex! This convenient location is close to everything - shopping, highways, Metro North Station, bus stops, Stamford High School, all just a few short minutes away. The open concept layout makes for an ideal setting as well - the kitchen and livingroom in the center, and on either side a bedroom with a walk-in depth closet and full bath. Unit is located on the top floor of the building (no neighbors above you!), with a set of stairs at the unit entrance but all of the living space is fully on one level. Own your piece of lovely Stamford CT at a great price. Set up your showing today! Agent/Owner.
